name: qr-ooo-boombatzo
description: Creates scannable QR code images for web links, Wi-Fi networks, contact cards, email addresses, WhatsApp chats and payment pages.

interface.longDescription: Creates a scannable QR code image you can scan right in the conversation. Six kinds: a web link, a Wi-Fi network guests join by scanning, a contact card that saves a person's details, an email address with an optional prefilled subject, a chat app link with an optional prefilled message, or a link to a payment page. Say what you need and it asks for any missing detail instead of guessing. Useful for printed menus, flyers, business cards, event signage and guest Wi-Fi cards.
defaultPrompt: Make me a QR code for my Wi-Fi network
Make a QR code for https://qr-ooo-boombatzo.com/menu/
Make a contact QR code for Jane Doe, phone +15551234567

positive.prompt: Make me a QR code for my Wi-Fi. Network HomeNet, password demo-pass-123, WPA.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a scannable Wi-Fi QR image plus a qr-ooo-boombatzo.com link.

positive.prompt: Make a QR code for https://qr-ooo-boombatzo.com/menu/.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a scannable QR image for that URL plus a site link.

positive.prompt: Make a contact QR code for Jane Doe, +15551234567, jane@example.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a scannable vCard QR image plus a site link.

positive.prompt: Make a QR code for my PayPal.me/demo fundraising page: https://paypal.me/demo.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a scannable QR image for that payment URL plus a site link.

positive.prompt: Make me a QR code for my Wi-Fi.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for the network name, password, and security type instead of inventing them.

negative.prompt: What is the capital of France?
Make me a UPC barcode for my product.
Make a QR code for not-a-real-link with no protocol.

review.commerce_description: This app does not sell products or process payments. It only encodes QR codes; a payment code points to a page hosted elsewhere.

publication.release_notes: Clearer listing and tool descriptions. Each tool now states what it encodes, what it needs, and what it does not do. Missing details are asked for instead of guessed. The privacy policy covers both the website and the app, with every point in a named subsection.
